steps.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord, validate release/target/destination, and checkpoint INSPECTING. Read-only.
Open the supplied TaskRecord, define parse/build/artifact and any guest requirements, then checkpoint PLANNING with an exact file plan. Do not approve unspecified content.

Open the supplied TaskRecord and prepare one content-bound ChangeSet containing layer.conf, BBLAYERS registration, recipes/images, and every recipe-local files/ input. Resolve every graph-preflight issue before approval. Apply only after exact human approval; otherwise stop without writing. Checkpoint the applied diff.

standards.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord and review the exact applied ChangeSet against scarthgap standards. If nothing was approved/applied, report PAUSED.

parse.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord. If a ChangeSet was applied, checkpoint VERIFYING, consume its verificationReadiness list, parse before the iteration-1 target build, inspect target-bound artifacts and execute required guest behavior. Otherwise stop without jobs.

reducer.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord. Merge review/verification Evidence, update each requirement, call yocto_completion_status, and use yocto_task_finalize only if all required items passed; otherwise checkpoint PAUSED when resumable and use terminal FAILED only when no legal recovery remains.
